text: おそいやないか　たのしんで　きたん？

structure.jp: たのしんで　きたん？
structure.en: did you go and have fun?

patterns.name: 〜じゃないか
patterns.explanation: じゃないか pushes a point at the listener: 'isn't it so!'. やないか is the Kansai dialect form that Bill speaks. おそいやないか = 'you're late, aren't you!'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: て-form + くる says someone went, did something, and came back. たのしんで きた = 'went and enjoyed yourself (and came back)'.

patterns.name: 〜の (question)
patterns.explanation: の at the end with a rising voice makes a casual question; ん is the Kansai dialect form. きたん？ = 'did you come?'.
